overview:
**Fire danger across the Montrose (High Elevation) zone is Moderate today, as dry fuels (ERC 64%, BI 69%) offset cool temps and light NNE winds.**

- Danger stays Moderate most of the week, dipping briefly to Low on Thursday, Oct. 15, before climbing back to Moderate through the weekend.
- A Pacific storm brings a 60% chance of showers/thunderstorms tonight and 50% Tuesday, with highs cooling into the upper 50s and winds shifting west-northwest.
- No Red Flag Warning is posted; 0 of 7 local watchout threshold conditions are currently met.
- Gunnison County is not currently under Fire Restrictions as of 12:01 a.m. Friday, September 18, 2026, and Ouray County fire restrictions were rescinded effective 12:01 a.m., Friday, September 18, 2026 — confirm status locally before any burning.
- Today's national interagency situation report shows no new large fires in the Rocky Mountain Area affecting Gunnison, Ouray, Montrose, or neighboring counties.
